notes: The repository's legacy checkpoint is not accepted as a trained model.
Training uses only supplied corpus text; there is no synthetic-data fallback.

required_data.train: 110,458,880 SentencePiece tokens of licensed, sourced Persian text
required_data.test: at least 1,000,000 separate held-out SentencePiece tokens
required_data.manifest: source/license names and HTTPS URLs, fa language, collection date, attribution, rights_to_train=true, privacy_reviewed=true, and SHA-256 for each split
